howto.name: Upload the PDF
howto.text: Select a PDF up to 500 MB.

howto.name: Define shapes
howto.text: For each shape, specify type (rectangle, ellipse, line, polygon), page number, coordinates, color, and stroke width.

howto.name: Apply and download
howto.text: Click Add Shapes. The shapes are drawn directly onto the page content; they survive copy-paste, printing, and PDF/A conversion.

faq.q: Are shapes flattened into the page?
faq.a: Yes — shapes become part of the page's content stream, not annotations. They can't be moved or deleted afterwards without re-editing the PDF.

faq.q: Can I draw filled or only outlined shapes?
faq.a: Both. Set fillColor for a filled shape; omit it and only the stroke renders. Set both for an outlined fill.
Use a color with alpha (e.g., rgba(255,0,0,0.5)) or pass an opacity value (0–1).
